name: fpvlink
description: Low-latency FPV streaming device software for Orange Pi 5 Plus (RK3588)
author: David Escobar
_dependencies_comment: setup/04-service.sh runs `npm install --omit=dev` at the install root, so THIS file provisions what web/server.js resolves at runtime. It must stay in step with web/package.json — a stale multer here is what server.js would actually load on the device.
